name: Pityriasis lichenoides chronica
advice: Harmless but relapses over months to years. Sunlight / narrowband UVB phototherapy helps widespread disease. Biopsy if lesions ulcerate or look unusual.
adviceText: Harmless but relapses over months to years. Sunlight / narrowband UVB phototherapy helps widespread disease. Biopsy if lesions ulcerate or look unusual.

rx.instr: Children: erythromycin 30–50 mg/kg/day; minocycline 100 mg OD alternative

rx.drug: Light liquid paraffin + white soft paraffin lotion
